reason: Migrates Codex CLI conversations, MCP configurations, memories, and optional project files into DeepSeek Harness artifacts and sessions, with documented local filesystem access and MCP registration output.

summaries.zh: 将 Codex CLI 的对话、MCP 配置、记忆和可选项目文件迁移为 DeepSeek Harness 会话及相关产物。
summaries.en: Migrates Codex CLI conversations, MCP configurations, memories, and optional project files into DeepSeek Harness sessions and related artifacts.

capabilities: Writes migrated artifacts within a configured output directory
Converts conversations into DSH sessions or Markdown
Copies memories, AGENTS.md, and optional project files
Generates MCP registration rows and registration prompts
